rule: Do not volunteer path detail unless the prospect specifically asks which license, 2-14 vs 2-15, what happens if they do not pass, or licensing-path details.
fallbackWhen: If a recruit does not successfully complete/pass the primary 2-14 path, we may offer the 2-15 option.
simpleRequirementPolicy: For ordinary questions like '¿Tengo que tener licencia?' / 'Do I need a license?', answer only that licensing training is part of the profession and resume the pending workflow — do not mention 2-14 or 2-15.
response_en: In Florida, the primary licensing path is the 2-14. If that path is not completed or passed successfully, we may offer the 2-15 option. During the interview we'll explain how the process works and how we'll support you.
response_es: En Florida, el camino principal de licencia es el 2-14. Si no se completa o no se aprueba ese camino, podemos ofrecer la opción del 2-15. Durante la entrevista te explican cómo funciona el proceso y cómo te acompañan.
